Adhesive bonding machine operators do more than switch machines on and off. They run adhesive application, pressing, and curing equipment; monitor flow, temperature, and pressure; perform changeovers and cleaning; inspect bonded surfaces; and resolve alarms so material layers join without bubbles or delamination. The work suits dependable people who can stand through shifts and tolerate repetition.
